implication_for_fy27: Expect the FY27 margin sentence only on 12 Feb 2027, as a floor set 0-50bp below the FY26 print (pattern file). Nothing quantified for FY27 costs today.

what_was_said: FY26 guide 'assumes a material increase in terms of the AI spend over the course of the year'; 'an expense that will ramp over the course of the year' (1Q26)
implication_for_fy27: The 2H26 run-rate of AI/inference opex, not the FY26 average, is the FY27 base: a ramp in 2H26 means FY27 carries a full year of it. Size undisclosed; sits in cost of revenue (hosting) and product development.

what_was_said: $1.7bn hosting commitment through 2031; purchase obligations $930m due in 1-3 years
implication_for_fy27: Hosting floor ~$283m/yr under the new agreement vs ~$224m/yr before; the 2027-28 tranche of purchase obligations (~$465m/yr incl. non-hosting) is roughly double the 2026 tranche ($219m). Cost of revenue ex-payments steps up in FY27.

what_was_said: 'we don't need to grow our head count at levels that we did in the past'; 2026 headcount and SBC growth 'lower than 2025' (+12.3% to ~8,200)
implication_for_fy27: FY27 product-development cash growth below the +11-12% of FY25/1H26 if the headcount claim holds; the FY24 'not above revenue growth' guide (C017) missed by 7pts, so discount to +8-10%.

unit: pct y/y support cost per booking (2Q26)

implication_for_fy27: Ops & support keeps falling per night through FY27 (the one line with a track record: 100% kept, n 13), but savings are partly reinvested (V020) and payroll/insurance/customer-relations components are rising ($41m/$9m/$14m in 1H26, 10-Q). Model -4 to -5%/yr per night, not -16%.

implication_for_fy27: Incentives are contra-revenue and unsized; if they persist into FY27 the ex-incentive take-rate lift never reaches revenue. FY27 take rate: flat is the base, +10-20bp only if incentives roll off.

implication_for_fy27: New launches in FY27 mean field-ops and launch marketing before revenue (the S100 pattern: investment front-runs revenue). No budget given; FY25's launch cost $200-250m.

implication_for_fy27: The expansion-market marketing load is structural (C023: scales down per unit only as markets mature). FY27 S&M growth above revenue growth is the base case; brand statements are 63% kept (n 35).

unit: usd_m buyback authorization remaining at 30 Jun 2026

implication_for_fy27: At ~$1.0-1.1bn/quarter the authorization runs out around 1Q27; a new authorization is the FY27 base case (each prior one was renewed before exhaustion).

implication_for_fy27: The FY27 guide will be a floor at or slightly below the FY26 print, not a step down: four years of 35-37% and every floor beaten (60-140bp). A step-change in AI opex is the one stated risk to that.

implication_for_fy27: FY25-26 field-ops headcount is sticky into FY27; hotels supply expansion adds go-to-market cost with single-digit-% revenue.
